runs.summary: Initial source and photo verification: Ferrari 360 and two TVRs passed. Three retained advert pages lacked current-stock evidence; a Tamora was under offer. Full-watchlist sweep remains in progress.

Discovery searches completed for all 70 model rows. New candidate links queued for actual-advert and visual photo verification; they are not live finds yet. Existing five car watches retained and hourly website sync created.

Recovered 92 advert links from car-watch history. Eight additional cars passed current advert and visual photo checks. Historical links remain separately labelled; duplicates, sold and unverified leads are not promoted to Latest finds. Original alert times are not available for every recovered report.

Checked all 92 source links. Four adverts marked sold, seven unavailable or removed, and one deposit taken. All 11 current finds rechecked with visible seller photographs; other unverified leads remain unpublished. Visitor sold reports now queue a seller-page recheck.

Two historical leads passed full verification: manual DB9 and Noble GTO-3R. Rechecked all 11 previous finds; no price changes. Executed 48 Facebook-group, eBay and Auto Trader queries for model rows 13–24 plus wider source searches and named exceptions. Search coverage is limited by public indexing; UK Super Cars group identity remains unverified. Ended eBay adverts, a sold Chimaera and unavailable M5 were rejected.

On-demand lower-price search: added a Honda S2000 at £17,995 and BMW Z4 M Roadster at £16,495 after original advert, current dealer inventory and visual photo checks. Repaired truncated upstream JSON using the last valid feed while preserving complete upstream records. Existing listing check times unchanged; this was not a full hourly sweep.
